reviews.text:
My puppy, Honey, got her first haircut from Victor.
We had never been to the salon before and when we walked in, the space was very comfortable and welcoming. Everyone we talked to was really nice.

We especially liked how we could see the dogs being groomed and maybe it was reassuring for Honey to be able to see us too.

The waiting area includes comfortable seating and free beverages. We even saw someone working while they waited for their dog to get their haircut.

Honey was a bit nervous and Victor took the time to make her feel comfortable. I had shown pictures of what I wanted and while there was a bit of difference from the photo I showed to her cut due to coat type, she looked very cute in the end. There are some spots that aren’t perfectly aligned but I know she was moving a lot so not all moments were perfect.

I had gone in expecting he would only wash and blow dry her which I completely understood due to it being her first time but I was so glad when he did a full haircut as she wasn’t able to see. I had explained we bathe her and bow dry her once a week and brush her daily and this was always a long process because of how long her fur was.

I have included a before and after photo :)
Felix did a phenomenal job with our golden!! Everyone was so professional and tested our pup with such love!
Excellent service.  My dog usually is very anxious,  but he loved the experience.  I found my new groomer.
Leslie and Lux did such a beautiful job on my pomeranians!
Had a great experience at Dashing Dog West Loop. Victor took great care of Lady. She came back looking great! I’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommend
Cris and his wife did an amazing job with our golden retriever Polly!! Highly recommend!

Lexi was my dog’s recent groomer and she had such a good experience! I have been going to this location and everything has been easy, convenient, and affordable. My dog is always happy when she leaves and I enjoy getting a little photo of her and a little stuffy.

This review is long overdue, but I have been bringing my dog here after relocating from out of state and couldn’t be happier. I did extensive research before coming here because I take his care very seriously, and I’m so glad I did!

Pam has taken such wonderful care of my little guy and showers him with so much love that I know he’s always in great hands. He tends to get separation anxiety (or maybe it’s just me 🤣), but he is always such a happy, calm boy at drop-off and pick-up. It’s a true testament to the cozy atmosphere and the trust she builds with him during his grooming sessions.

Also, after each trip, you get a goody bag with a cute photo of your pet and a stuffed animal to take home. It’s such a fun experience for our fur babies!

We’ve been coming here for a year and sometimes the cuts are good and other times they aren’t. This most recent cut was the worst I’ve ever seen. It’s so choppy and extremely lopsided so there’s literally no way to fix it. If there were other grooming places close by we wouldn’t keep coming here.
